narrative.overview:
มอ.จัดตารางเรียน treats semester schedule planning as a physical studio craft rather than a bureaucratic spreadsheet chore. The interface is modeled after an illuminated architectural drafting table: warm vellum drafting paper (#F6F4EF), exposed 1px ruling hairlines (#D8D3C8), and translucent Lucite film course blocks that stack, slide, and lock cleanly onto a calibrated 7-day × half-hour time matrix.

Because students routinely customize their timetable with personal wallpapers—from campus photos and anime illustrations to dark-mode gradients—every course tile and coordinate ruler is engineered with adaptive frosted glass (backdrop-filter: blur(8px)) and a saturated 4px left color spine. Even over busy user-uploaded photography, Thai diacritics and monospace course codes remain crisp and scannable at a glance.

The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS dashboard bloat (nested KPI widgets, decorative charts, marketing hero banners, and uncalibrated neon palettes). Every pixel serves spatial orientation, conflict detection, and studio-grade PNG export.
keyCharacteristics: Illuminated Vellum Canvas: Warm off-white drafting paper (#F6F4EF) paired with exposed 1px engineering hairlines (#D8D3C8) and tick marks along the time ruler.

Translucent Lucite Course Blocks: Frosted acrylic blocks (backdrop-filter: blur(8px)) with a 4px left color spine and top-right section pill (SEC 01) that stay legible over any custom background photo.
Tabular Precision: Course codes (344-211), section numbers, credit counters, and exam dates are always set in JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

Tactile Physics & Ghost Slots: Dragging a course block lifts it with subtle tilt (scale(1.02) rotate(-0.8deg)) while illuminating dashed ghost drop zones for all valid official SIS sections of that subject.

rules.name: The Lucite Legibility Rule
rules.body: Course blocks on the timetable canvas must never use opaque flat fills that obscure the grid's drafting lines, nor raw transparent text that disappears over user photos; always pair an 84%–92% translucent tinted surface with backdrop-filter: blur(8px) and a solid 4px left accent spine.

rules.name: The Vermilion Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Clash Vermilion (#DC2626) is reserved exclusively for time overlaps, exam date collisions, and destructive removal actions—never as a decorative course color.

rules.name: The Tabular Coordinate Rule
rules.body: Every course code, section badge, time-axis label, credit counter, and exam date must use JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns align like an architectural title block.

rules.name: The Thai Diacritic Breathing Rule
rules.body: Course block titles and Thai labels must maintain a minimum line-height of 1.32 with overflow: hidden only on outer containers—never clipping upper tone marks (วรรณยุกต์) or lower vowels (สระอุ/อู).

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Authority Rule
rules.body: Never use drop shadows to separate timetable rows or columns; the calendar matrix relies exclusively on 1px solid full-bleed ruling lines and subtle alternating row tints.

dos: Do preserve 1px solid structural grid hairlines across both the time ruler and day rows so the calendar always reads like a precision drafting table.
Do use JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for all 6-digit PSU course codes, section numbers, credit totals, and exam dates.
Do ensure custom background images pass through the adjustable overlay tint (--custom-bg-opacity) and blur (--custom-bg-blur) layer so course blocks remain effortless to read.
Do surface both class-time overlaps and Mid/Final exam date collisions immediately with #DC2626 badges and diagonal hatching.
donts: Don't introduce multi-page navigation, login walls, or decorative SaaS KPI cards above the workbench; the app opens directly into the functional studio.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left); use GPU-composited transform (scaleX, translateY, rotate) and opacity only.
Don't use opaque dark fills on course blocks that hide the underlying drafting grid or clash with user-uploaded photography.
Don't clip Thai upper tone marks or lower vowels inside compact schedule cells; maintain line-height >= 1.3 on Thai labels.
